active-command-module-owners.text: As a contributor, I need the command entry points to show which module owns an option, scenario, control and observation while keeping the existing executable boundary.

dependency-direction.text: Component-local code may share a helper only when both callers already use the same semantics and the dependency direction is one-way. No command imports a sibling command's scenario or control. The existing journey/verifier, journey/retire-verify and older naming journeys are independent evidence surfaces and are excluded.
